A report's tokens

Source: R/spec_code.R
tfl_report_tokens.Rd

The values a report's header, footer, titles and footnotes fill their {TOKENS} with – the study's, the report's own rows, and the report's own tokens it says (OUTPUT_LABEL "Table 14.1.1" ...) – as tfl_report_code() gives them to rtf_document(tokens = ): for a preview of the page.

Usage

tfl_report_tokens(spec, output_id = NULL)

Arguments

spec

A report definition (tfl_read_report_spec()) narrowed to one report, or the path(s) to read it from.

output_id

The report, when spec is a path or still defines several.

Value

A named character vector (none: empty).

Examples

sp <- tfl_table_spec(
  report = data.frame(output_id = "T-14-1-1", type = "table"),
  header = data.frame(output_id = NA, line = "1", center = "{OUTPUT_LABEL}"))
tfl_report_tokens(sp, "T-14-1-1")
#>   OUTPUT_LABEL 
#> "Table 14.1.1"
